en.name: Irabu Bridge & Sea Drive
en.description: Japan's longest toll-free bridge spanning 3,540 meters over emerald clear ocean, connecting Miyako Island to Irabu Island with exhilarating ocean drive vistas.
highlights: Drive the curving 3,540m ocean highway hovering right over turquoise sea
Stop at observation parking bays on both ends for photos of the bridge arch
Continue driving on Irabu Island to Shimojishima Airport 17END runway beach
en.parkingInfo: Free viewing plaza parking lots located on both Miyako and Irabu bridgeheads.

ja.name: 伊良部大橋
ja.description: 宮古島と伊良部島を結ぶ全長3,540mの橋。通行無料の橋としては日本最長であり、エメラルドグリーンの海の上を滑るように走る爽快ドライブコース。
highlights: 海の上を駆け抜ける3.5kmの絶景ドライブ体験
橋の全貌を捉える両岸（宮古島側・伊良部島側）の絶景展望スポット
橋を渡って下地島空港17ENDの幻のビーチ散策へステップアップ
ja.parkingInfo: 両端の橋詰に無料展望駐車場あり。

highlights: 3,540-metre bridge connecting Miyako and Irabu islands
Free to cross — popular photo stop
notes: Japan's longest toll-free bridge — stop at the roadside station for panoramic photos.
